title: Dates YYYY-MM-DD from DateTimeGenerator and from a script (campaign b5, e06)
proves: DateTimeGenerator bounds with the time (the default layout) and outDateFormat="%Y-%m-%d" give a date text inside both ends, on a <key> and on a <variable>
the call form of the message, DateTimeGenerator(min='2026-01-01', max='2026-03-31', input_format='%Y-%m-%d') with outDateFormat, builds as written
the attribute form and the call form of the bounds give the same rows, and another layout in the call with input_format gives the same rows as the default layout
a date-only min, max or value without input_format is refused with a message that names the argument, the default layout, both working forms and outDateFormat for both
a configured input_format that does not match keeps its own message; the unit test test_custom_input_format_mismatch_does_not_recommend_the_default pins its exact text
without outDateFormat neither form gives a date text, and the bounds are applied
a script has the datetime module without import: __import__ is refused with DM314 and its fix
a raw < in an XML attribute is refused as not well-formed XML, with the < fix that the overview also shows

negatives.name: date_only_min_attribute_form
negatives.message: DateTimeGenerator min does not match the default layout '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'. Write the time too, for example min="2026-01-01 00:00:00" max="2026-03-31 23:59:59", or pass the layout in the call

negatives.name: date_only_max_attribute_form
negatives.message: DateTimeGenerator max does not match the default layout

negatives.name: date_only_min_call_form
negatives.message: or pass the layout in the call: DateTimeGenerator(min='2026-01-01', max='2026-03-31', input_format='%Y-%m-%d'). Both forms give a datetime: add outDateFormat="%Y-%m-%d" for a date text such as 2026-03-31.

negatives.name: date_only_value
negatives.message: DateTimeGenerator value does not match the default layout

negatives.name: configured_input_format_mismatch
negatives.message: DateTimeGenerator min does not match the configured input_format

negatives.name: script_imports_the_datetime_module
negatives.remediation: Scripts have no __import__; the datetime module is there: datetime.date(2026, 1, 1).

negatives.name: raw_less_than_in_an_attribute
negatives.remediation: Inside an attribute value write < as < and & as &, for example script="a <= b"
